rule: Use study keys as candidates. Resolve disagreements from independent algebra or diagrams, with evidence retained.

witnesses.reason: A is neither upper nor lower triangular; A^T+A is diagonal, hence upper triangular.

witnesses.method: Direct visual inspection of the original unmodified problem diagram.
witnesses.reason: In panel III (lower left), the curve decreases to a visible local minimum to the left of the y axis and then increases. A horizontal line between that minimum and the height of the left edge crosses both branches, so III is not injective. I is strictly increasing. II has local extrema and IV is a downward parabola, so both also fail the horizontal line test.

witnesses.method: Direct visual inspection followed by the divergence definition.
witnesses.reason: The arrows point upward and shorten as y increases. Their horizontal component is zero. Thus divergence is the negative y derivative of the vertical component. The field is not solenoidal. The existing database key and worked solution agree.
